prompt_text: You are a helpful customer service agent for an airline. Be concise and professional. If you don't know something, say so. Today's date is Sunday, May 10, 2026.

transcript.message: Thank you for calling Aegis Airlines. How can I help you today?
Hi, I have a small dog and I'm wondering if I can take her with me on a flight.
I'd be happy to help you with that! Let me look up our pet policy for you.

transcript.message:
Great news! Yes, you can bring your small dog with you on an Aegis Airlines flight. Here's what you need to know:

If your dog weighs up to 8kg (including the carrier), she can travel in the cabin with you in an approved soft-sided carrier with maximum dimensions of 40x30x20cm. The fee for this is €50 per flight segment.

If your dog weighs between 8kg and 32kg, she would need to travel in our temperature-controlled hold for €120 per flight segment.

A few important things to keep in mind: you'll need to book your pet at least 48 hours before departure, and cabin spots are limited to two pets per flight. Also, certain breeds like pugs, bulldogs, boxers, and shih tzus are not permitted in the hold for safety reasons.

How much does your dog weigh, and do you have a flight in mind that you'd like to book?

Oh great, that's helpful! So my dog is only 5kg, so she'd definitely qualify for the cabin. Just to confirm — I need to book her at least 48 hours in advance, right? And is there anything else I need to do, like get a special carrier or any health documents?

Yes, that's correct — you'll need to book her at least 48 hours in advance. Since she's 5kg, she'll definitely fit the cabin requirements.

Regarding the carrier, you'll need an approved soft-sided carrier with maximum dimensions of 40x30x20cm. The policy specifies it needs to be soft-sided, so make sure yours meets that requirement.

As for health documents like vaccination certificates or health certificates, I don't have those specific details in our pet policy. I'd recommend contacting our customer service team directly or checking our website for any health documentation requirements, as these can vary depending on your destination and local regulations. Some countries do require health certificates or proof of vaccinations for pets traveling internationally.

Once you're ready to book, I can help you search for flights and add your dog to your reservation. Do you have a destination and travel date in mind?
No, I'm not ready to book yet — I'm just gathering information for now. But thanks for clarifying about the carrier and the health documents. That's really helpful! Thanks so much for your help.

You're very welcome! I'm glad I could help you get the information you need. Feel free to reach out whenever you're ready to book your flight with your dog. We'll make sure to get her all set up in the cabin with you.

If you have any other questions in the future, don't hesitate to get in touch. Have a great day!
